note: Each original's digest includes its delivery's source revision, so any edit to the Registerinformation file, here another register's data length, stales base although its own rows are unchanged. A changed definition, register parent or physical row count of base's own originals is an edit of the same file and reaches the build the same way.
fails_if: the native partition's digest stops covering the complete original record (its source revision and every field, parent fact and physical row), so base's partition still applies on a changed Registerinformation delivery
